instruct: A mature male narrator with a deep, resonant bass-baritone voice, a weathered grain and a clear British English accent. An ancient storyteller proclaiming a Norse saga. Solemn authority, dark grandeur, emotionally committed theatrical delivery. Deliberate phrasing with meaningful silence. Keep the same vocal identity throughout. Clear consonants and natural breaths. Speak with quiet dread, an ominous, measured prophecy. Let the last warning grow into a resonant command. Do not rush or yell.
